questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Capillaria philippinensis?
options: Eggs, larvae or adult fragments in stool.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Eggs, larvae or adult fragments in stool. Repeated stool microscopy may be required; 400× helps resolve striations and polar plugs.
